nodes.statement: The fixed-rate transfer has an exact geometric half-life that pins the crossover: the analytic half-life is n½ = ln2 / ln(1/0.85) = 4.265 ticks, so the source first falls to or below half the seeded total (0.5) at tick 5 -- which is exactly the tick at which the sink overtakes the source. The two landmarks (half-drained source, sink/source crossover) coincide because store_b = 1 - store_a, so store_b > store_a precisely when store_a < 0.5. Confirmed in-memory on fig01-runnable (store_a first <= 0.5 at tick 5, value 0.4437 == 0.85^5; interior exactness store_a[10] == 0.85^10 == 0.196874), so the crossover is not a tuned coincidence but a deterministic consequence of the single rate constant.

nodes.label: The loop's environmental-modification leg is measurable: the cell draws down ...
nodes.statement: The loop's environmental-modification leg is measurable: the cell draws down the very gradient it climbs. The local chemical field the cell senses at its grid index falls from 0.5 at the start to 0.2407 by the end of the 24-tick run -- a net drawdown driven by diffusion smoothing the seeded 0->1 gradient and by the cell's own uptake removing mass at its footprint. Yet per-step uptake still tracks that falling local field at correlation 1.0 throughout, so the coupling holds even as the driver relaxes. This is the half of the control loop that distinguishes it from a one-way driver: cellular output modifies the shared environmental state (panel b), confirmed in-memory on fig04-runnable.

nodes.label: Fig 5b's grain swap is not cosmetic: realizing the SAME coarse-metabolism int...
nodes.statement: Fig 5b's grain swap is not cosmetic: realizing the SAME coarse-metabolism interface at three different model grains gives measurably different biomass through byte-identical ports. The companion executables fig05-executable-{coarse,kinetic,fba} install three internal mechanisms behind one shared interface (biomass, energy, entropy, secretions over a fixed supply) -- a linear coarse law, a saturating kinetic (Michaelis-Menten) law, and a flux-balance (FBA) law. Measured in-memory over the standard executable run (workbench 0.4.1): final biomass is 4.0 (coarse) / 2.6667 (kinetic) / 6.2936 (FBA) -- a 2.4x spread -- with the FBA grain additionally secreting 30.4478 of acetate (overflow metabolism) against 1.6 for coarse, and energy 144.0 / entropy 151.2761 far above the coarse grain's 2.4 / 0.8. Choosing the grain changes the quantitative readout the shared interface reports, which is exactly why switching the active level of description (Fig 5b's selector) is a substantive modeling act. These are toy-real magnitudes; the point is the measurable grain-dependence, not a calibrated biomass yield.

nodes.label: The ATP-flux sweep is produced by the proton-drive ramp, not by the rate law ...
nodes.statement: The ATP-flux sweep is produced by the proton-drive ramp, not by the rate law itself -- shown by contrasting the bare figure draft against the driven transducer. The bare draft `fig06-executable` pins the substrate/proton activity at chemical_in = 1.0 and so reports a FLAT ATP turnover of chemical_out = 100.0 = k_cat (no ProtonMotiveRamp wired; its electrical, mechanical, and thermal output channels read 0.0 in the bare draft). Adding the ramp in `fig06-runnable` charges chemical_in from 0.2 to ~1.34, and because J_ATP = k_cat * activity the ATP flux then sweeps 20.0 -> 128.0 over the run while all four channels co-fire. The sweep is therefore the environment->transducer coupling (the ramp driving the proton flux), not an intrinsic nonlinearity of the mechanism -- the paper's point that at the molecular level interactions are governed by the driving flux, made measurable. Verified in-memory (workbench 0.4.1): fig06-executable chemical_out flat 100.0; fig06-runnable chemical_out 20.0 at first drive, rising linearly with activity.

nodes.label: Six ODE processes wired over one place graph nesting up to six levels deep --...
nodes.statement: Six ODE processes wired over one place graph nesting up to six levels deep -- WITHOUT flattening the compartment hierarchy -- run to completion as one coupled cell and drive a non-trivial change at EVERY level of the nested hierarchy.
